scenes.title: Aeroacoustics Tandem Rotor Inspection Bay
scenes.institution: Penn State Aeroacoustics Lab — open-jet anechoic rotor test station
scenes.reference_notes: Official experiment photograph inspected: two propeller heads in tandem, one on an upward pedestal and another on a suspended motor stack, with hanging microphones against deep brown acoustic wedges. Page describes this as a multirotor configuration in the open-jet flow-through anechoic facility. Local apparatus view; full chamber boundaries and support attachment above frame are not completely visible. Rotors should be represented by bounded mechanical indexing; no acoustic, aerodynamic or propulsive predictions.

Asymmetric upward and suspended propeller assemblies define a tandem test geometry.
Thin hanging microphone array and instrument leads frame the rotor region.
